2021_211_5_c_2021_lease_rfp_docs_ocmw_tr.paragraph: Complete procurement packet for RFP 9929, the Troy School District solicitation for professional office space to house Oakland County Michigan Works! Troy, assembled for the September 2021 Board award. The existing lease at 550 Stephenson Hwy, Suite 400 expires October 31, 2021, and the replacement lease was advertised as a five-year term beginning November 1, 2021 and ending October 31, 2026. Two firms responded, L. Mason Capitani and Friedman Real Estate; the evaluation committee scored L Mason Capitani 95 of 100 points against Friedman's 85, and its 7,494 square foot proposal at $14.00 per square foot for 2021-22 was identified as the most reasonable and cost-effective option.
2021_211_5_c_2021_lease_rfp_docs_ocmw_tr.page:
**What it is**
A multi-part packet supporting the award of a building lease for Oakland County Michigan Works! Troy (OCMW! Troy), operated by Troy School District. It combines a preliminary lease cost estimate memo, a lease rationale, the full RFP 9929 solicitation document, the announcement email and newspaper advertisement, the two vendor proposals, and SAM.gov registration search screenshots.

**Need for a new lease**
The district's lease at 550 Stephenson Hwy, Suite 400 expires October 31, 2021. The facility requires a 3-5 year lease to maintain operations of what the packet describes as the premier One Stop Service Center in Oakland County, serving 17,000+ job seekers and hundreds of area businesses annually.

**Market comparison (Signature Associates, at no cost to the district)**

| Property | Rate |
| --- | --- |
| 3221 W. Big Beaver, Troy | $17.00/sq ft + electric |
| 3270 W. Big Beaver Road, Troy | $15.50/sq ft + electric |
| 2855 Coolidge Hwy, Troy | $17.50/sq ft + electric |
| 2800 Livernois Rd, Troy | $17.95/sq ft + electric |
| 850 Stephenson Hwy, Troy | $13.00/sq ft + electric |
| 700 Tower Dr., Troy | $17.95 - 18.95/sq ft + electric |

Moving costs are estimated to average $150,000.00 - $200,000.00, covering technology upgrades, server relocation, buildout, packing, furniture and other unexpected costs.

**Solicitation**
RFP 9929 was announced publicly Tuesday, August 3, 2021, posted to www.troy.k12.mi.us, emailed by Purchasing Supervisor Todd Hensley at 9:01:04 AM that day, and distributed through State of Michigan SIGMA VSS/DM to an additional 19 contacts. Direct recipients were Robbins Investments 550 LLC (Rob Krochmal), L. Mason Capitani Corfac International (Mason Capitani), Winston-Traitel Realty, Inc (Jeff Raitt), Friedman Integrated Real Estate Solutions (Robert Gagniuk) and Thomas Duke Realty (Rachel Pannell). Questions were due by noon Wednesday, August 11, 2021; proposals by 1:00 p.m. Wednesday, August 18, 2021 at the Purchasing Department, 1140 Rankin, Troy, Michigan 48083.

**Proposed lease costs**

| Year | L Mason Capitani | SF | $/SF | Friedman Real Estate | SF | $/SF |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2021-22 | $104,916.00 | 7,494 | $14.00 | $105,000.00 - $150,000.00 | 7,000 - 10,000 | $15.00 |
| 2022-23 | $106,789.50 | 7,494 | $14.25 | $107,100.00 - $153,000.00 | 7,000 - 10000 | $15.30 |
| 2023-24 | $110,536.00 | 7,494 | $14.75 | $109,270.00 - $156,100.00 | 7,000 - 10,000 | $15.61 |
| 2024-25 | $112,410.00 | 7,494 | $15.00 | $111,440.00 - $159,200.00 | 7,000 - 10,000 | $15.92 |
| 2025-26 | $114,283.50 | 7,494 | $15.25 | $113,680.00 - $162,400.00 | 7,000 - 10,000 | $16.24 |

All bid amounts are plus electric and include daily janitorial services; L Mason Capitani costs include maintenance (CAM) while Friedman's are additional. Friedman's first year is $15.00/sq ft with a 2% annual increase and amortized leasing costs to be determined.

**Scoring**
Reviewed by Todd Hensley (Purchasing Supervisor), Denise Van Hee (Director, OCMW! Troy) and Cheryl Schubeck (Program Coordinator, OCMW! Troy), with final scores the average of all three. L Mason Capitani scored 45/25/25 for 95 total points; Friedman Real Estate scored 40/20/25 for 85 total points. L Mason Capitani was found most reasonable and cost-effective, with rate per square foot below current market rates and moving described as very costly.

**Friedman proposal**
Friedman offered +/- 7,000 to 10,000 RSF on the second or third floor of North Troy Corporate Park, 5505 Corporate Drive, Troy, MI 48084, owned by Oakland County Health Network.
2021_211_5_c_2021_lease_rfp_docs_ocmw_tr.verbose:
Procurement packet assembled for the Troy School District Board of Education covering RFP 9929, Professional Office Space Lease, Oakland County Michigan Works, Troy Public Schools. Tabbed sections cover Preliminary Lease Cost, Lease Rationale, the RFP - Building Lease document, the Email to Vendors Announcing RFP, the Press Release/Newspaper Ad, the L Mason Capitani and Friedman Real Estate proposals, and SAM.gov entity searches.

**Need for a new lease.** Troy School District's (Oakland County Michigan Works! Troy) lease at 550 Stephenson Hwy, Suite 400 is set to expire on October 31, 2021. The facility needs a 3-5 year lease to maintain operations of the premier One Stop Service Center in Oakland County, which provides workforce services to 17,000+ job seekers and hundreds of area businesses on a yearly basis.

**Cost reasonableness and market comparison.** Troy School District (Troy Michigan Works) used Signature Associates, at no cost to the district, to obtain quotes for comparable facilities and lease requirements. The 2021 quotes listed are: 3221 W. Big Beaver, Troy, MI at $17.00 per square foot plus electric; 3270 W. Big Beaver Road, Troy, MI at $15.50 per square foot plus electric; 2855 Coolidge Hwy, Troy, MI at $17.50 per square foot plus electric; 2800 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI at $17.95 per square foot plus electric; 850 Stephenson Hwy, Troy, MI at $13.00 per square foot plus electric; and 700 Tower Dr., Troy, MI at $17.95 - 18.95 per square foot plus electric.

**Moving costs.** The district estimates moving costs could average $150,000.00 - $200,000.00, including technology upgrades, moving servers, buildout of a new facility, moving and packing costs, furniture costs, and other unexpected moving-related costs.

**Public bid process.** RFP 9929 was announced publicly on Tuesday, August 3, 2021, with a newspaper announcement included in the packet, and made available on the district website, www.troy.k12.mi.us. The RFP was sent directly to Robbins Investments 550 LLC, Rob Krochmal, 248-867-3304, robk@surnow.com; L. Mason Capitani Corfac International, Mason Capitani, 248-637-7795, MLCapitani@lmcap.com; Winston-Traitel Realty, Inc, Jeff Raitt, 248-624-7200, jraitt@wtrealty.com; Friedman Integrated Real Estate Solutions, Robert Gagniuk, 248-830-9400, robert.gagniuk@freg.com; and Thomas Duke Realty, Rachel Pannell, 248-476-3700, info@thomasduke.com. The district additionally used State of Michigan SIGMA VSS/DM, which included an additional 19 contacts. L. Mason Capitani and Friedman Real Estate submitted proposals by the August 18th, 2021 deadline. The announcement email was sent by Todd Hensley on Tuesday, August 3, 2021 at 9:01:04 AM to info@thomasduke.com, Robk@surnow.com, MLCapitani@Imcap.com, Greggory.Kent@freg.com and jraitt@wtrealty.com, with the attachment RFP 9929 Oakland County MI Works Office Space.pdf.

**RFP terms.** Troy Schools accepted firm, sealed proposals to establish a five-year building lease beginning November 1, 2021 and ending October 31, 2026, annually renewed. Proposals and two copies marked RFP 9929 MI Works Professional Office Space Lease were due no later than 1:00 p.m., Wednesday, August 18, 2021 at the Purchasing Department, Troy School District, 1140 Rankin, Troy, Michigan 48083, where bids would be publicly opened and read aloud. Questions were accepted in writing only, due no later than noon Wednesday, August 11, 2021, by fax to 248.823.4077 or email to PurchasingOffice@troy.k12.mi.us. The stated timeline lists RFP released Tuesday, August 3, 2021; pre-proposal questions due Wednesday, August 11, 2021 at noon; proposals due Wednesday, August 18, 2021 at 1:00 PM; and Board award September 2021. Proposals remain firm for a minimum of 180 days after opening. The undersigned agrees to execute a contract if notified of acceptance within thirty days after opening, and bids may not be withdrawn until after forty-five (45) days after receipt of bids. Termination of the Agreement upon regulatory order requires thirty (30) days written prior notice.

Vendors must submit sworn and notarized familial disclosure statements covering relationships with any member of the Troy School Board or the Troy Schools Superintendent, plus a completed Iran Economic Sanctions affidavit under Michigan Public Act No. 517 of 2012. A false certification carries a civil penalty of not more than $250,000.00 or two (2) times the amount of the contract, whichever is greater, plus investigation costs and reasonable attorney fees, and ineligibility to bid for three (3) years. Insurance requirements include satisfactory Workers' Compensation coverage and General Liability and Property Damage Insurance of at least $1,000,000.00 per occurrence and $1,000,000.00 in aggregate, plus automobile insurance of at least $1,000,000.00. Registration on www.sam.gov is required, and vendors must certify they are not debarred from doing business with the federal government. The district is a tax-exempt entity except where the project makes enhancements or additions to real property, and is subject to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act.

**Scoring criteria and specifications.** Each responsive proposal is scored on a 100 point scale: Location and proximity to client population, 50 points; Cost Reasonableness, 25 points; Lease requirements, 25 points. Specifications require no less than 7000 square feet and no more than 8,000 square feet, free public parking including at least one handicapped space, public transportation access within walking distance, at least 4 bathrooms, a kitchen facility with running water, and accessibility for internet, wireless and telephone technology. The contract must permit termination without penalty costs or fees should federal funds or other applicable funding sources become unavailable.

**Lease cost comparison.** L Mason Capitani proposed 7,494 square feet at $14.00 per square foot for a 2021-22 lease cost of $104,916.00; $14.25 and $106,789.50 for 2022-23; $14.75 and $110,536.00 for 2023-24; $15.00 and $112,410.00 for 2024-25; and $15.25 and $114,283.50 for 2025-26. Friedman Real Estate proposed 7,000 - 10,000 square feet at $15.00 per square foot for $105,000.00 - $150,000.00 in 2021-22; $15.30 for $107,100.00 - $153,000.00 in 2022-23; $15.61 for $109,270.00 - $156,100.00 in 2023-24; $15.92 for $111,440.00 - $159,200.00 in 2024-25; and $16.24 for $113,680.00 - $162,400.00 in 2025-26. Notes state the first year is $15.00 per square foot with a 2% annual increase shown in the quote, additional amortized leasing costs to be determined, that all bid amounts are plus electric and include daily janitorial services, and that L Mason Capitani costs include maintenance (CAM) costs while Friedman's are additional.

**Bid scoring.** Bids were reviewed and scored by a committee of Todd Hensley, Purchasing Supervisor, Troy School District; Denise Van Hee, Director, Oakland County Michigan Works! Troy; and Cheryl Schubeck, Program Coordinator, Oakland County Michigan Works! Troy. Final scores reflect the average of all three scores in each category. On Location/Proximity to client Population (50 pts), L Mason Capitani received 45 for close proximity to a bus stop and two expressways (696 and I-75) and the Troy/Clawson/Madison Heights population served, while Friedman received 40 for close proximity to a bus stop and one expressway (I-75) and the Troy/Rochester Hills population. On Cost Reasonableness (25 pts), L Mason Capitani received 25 for an overall rate of $14 - $15 per square foot with maintenance included, below market rates, and no cost for moving expenses, buildouts or technology; Friedman received 20 for a rate of $15 - $16.24 per square foot in line with market rates but higher than current costs, with maintenance additional and additional moving and technology expenses. Both received 25 on Lease Requirements (25 pts), each meeting space, parking, kitchen and bathroom requirements and allowing lease termination with notice for financial reasons. Totals were 95 for L Mason Capitani and 85 for Friedman. All three committee members scored L Mason Capitani 45/25/25 and Friedman Real Estate 40/20/25. The summary concludes L Mason Capitani received the highest evaluation score and is the most reasonable and cost-effective option, with a proposed rate per square foot below current market rates and moving described as very costly.

**Friedman proposal detail.** Dated Aug 18, 2021 and presented by Robert Gagniuk, Real Estate Specialist, Client Solutions, robert.gagniuk@freg.com, 248.848.4093, ECODE 737, with Anya Eliassen copied, the Friedman Integrated Real Estate Solutions proposal covers North Troy Corporate Park, 5505 Corporate Drive, Troy, MI 48084. Oakland County Health Network (OCHN) is the owning entity, leasing excess office and meeting space to a network of providers. The proposal covers +/- 7,000 to 10,000 square feet on the second or third floor, with the second floor total available at +/- 23,507 SF and the third floor at +/- 7,710 SF; measurements are per ANSI/BOMA 2010. The term commences upon substantial completion with a target date of October 1, 2021, with early entry permitted thirty (30) days prior for FF&E installation. The rental rate goal is at or below $15.00/RSF plus suite electric, with Year 1 at $15.00/SF + E, amortized leasing costs TBD and 2% annual increases; base rent includes base year expenses, base year real estate taxes and five (5) nights per week of janitorial service. Tenant pays its pro-rata share of increases over the 2021 calendar base year, with a gross-up if the building is less than ninety-five percent (95%) leased. The security deposit equals one month's base rent based on the third month of the term. Parking is free at a ratio of 5.86/1000 SF, 748 spaces in total including 19 barrier free spaces. The building offers 24/7 access 365 days per year, a pneumatic VAV HVAC system with computer-controlled energy management, high-speed fiber optic data, a renovated lobby, full gym and locker rooms, cafe and sundry shop. Listed area amenities include Jimmy Johns, Cedar Grille, Red Robin, Kirby's Coney Island, Papa Romano Pizza, Bagel Factory, Sushi Do, Embassy Suites, Courtyard Marriott, Drury Inn & Suites, Detroit Marriott, MET Hotel, MJR Digital Cinemas, Somerset Mall, Ridgedale Players, Northfield Market and Sylvan Glen Golf Course. Friedman's headquarters is 34975 W. Twelve Mile Rd, Farmington Hills, MI 48331, 248.324.2000. The proposal remains in effect only until October 1, 2021 and is not contractually binding.

**SAM.gov searches.** Screenshots of General Services Administration SAM entity searches for the entity names "l mason capitani" and "friedman real estate" show "No matches found" for active records.
